## Cheque Management System

*Desktop app · Zahrh Esther Hardware Trading LLC, Sharjah, UAE · in daily use since October 2026*

A Windows app to write, print, save and track supplier cheques for a hardware trading
company. The finance team uses it with **real cheque books, real suppliers and real
printed cheques**, on several office computers sharing one database.

- **Printing that matches the paper.** A cheque layout designer with per-bank offsets
  (verified on SIB and RAK Bank cheques), range printing, and amounts converted to words.
- **The whole cheque life cycle:** pending, printed, cleared, bounced, stopped, cancelled
  and spoiled, plus security cheques, received customer cheques, supplier bills and
  balances, payment vouchers, a calendar view and reports.
- **Built for an office, not a demo:** user roles (Admin and Staff), auto-lock, a full
  change log, password-protected daily backups, and an **offline mode** that saves and
  prints cheques without internet and syncs them later.
- **Engineering discipline:** a pnpm monorepo with pure business rules in their own
  package (**100% test coverage enforced** for money, words and dates), database migrations
  tested in PGlite against every role and function, Row-Level Security in Supabase, and a
  hardened Electron setup (context isolation, sandbox, no secret keys in the app).

::: {.chips .lg}

:::

## Pakistan Plants: billing for nurseries

*Mobile app · iOS and Android · used day to day by businesses in Lahore*

A billing and credit-tracking app made for Pakistani plant nurseries, fully bilingual in
**English and Urdu** (Noto Nastaliq, right-to-left layout).

- **Invoices in seconds** from a catalogue of **280+ plants** with English and Urdu names,
  eight bill templates, PDF sharing straight to WhatsApp and automatic invoice numbering.
- **Udhaar (credit) tracking** per customer, partial and advance payments, overdue alerts
  and ageing buckets (0–30, 31–60, 60+ days).
- **Reports** by date, client and plant, exported to PDF or CSV; a customer database with
  contact import and one-tap call or WhatsApp.
- Store listings, privacy policy, terms and a testing checklist prepared for release.

::: {.chips .lg}
[React Native / Expo]{} [TypeScript]{} [Supabase]{} [i18n (EN / UR, RTL)]{} [PDF generation]{} [EAS]{}
:::
:::

::: {.proj #dimsum-pos}
## DimSum POS: a restaurant point-of-sale

*Desktop app · for my family's restaurant in Lahore*

An offline-first Windows point-of-sale system, designed from how the restaurant actually
runs: I also manage its staff, suppliers and marketing.

- **Specified before it was coded:** a software requirements specification, an
  entity-relationship design, the architecture, 16 user flows, a screen and permission
  matrix and wireframes, then milestones.
- **Orders** for dine-in, takeaway, phone delivery and Foodpanda (with channel pricing);
  kitchen tickets and customer receipts on a **thermal printer**.
- **Controls:** PIN login for owner and cashiers, discounts and voids that need the owner's
  PIN, refunds with reason codes, inventory with low-stock alerts, expenses, and shift
  closing with cash reconciliation.

::: {.chips .lg}
[Electron]{} [React]{} [TypeScript]{} [Drizzle ORM]{} [Thermal printing]{} [Turborepo]{}
:::
:::

## Excel automation suite for finance

*Desktop app · Zahrh Esther Hardware Trading LLC · 2022*

My first software for the business: a Python desktop application that replaced a manual
Excel routine for the chief accountant. It loads the month's transaction files, categorises
them automatically and produces financial summaries to download, cutting manual data
entry and the errors that come with it.

::: {.proj #eyeq}
## EyeQ: eye tracking for learning

*Final-year project · BSc Computer Science, Bahria University*

A cross-platform mobile app that tracks students' eye movements with computer vision to
estimate how difficult a quiz question is and how attentive the learner is. The capture
and analysis code was written and optimised for real-time feedback, with TensorFlow and
PyTorch models and Firebase for data, and the app was **tested with 20 students**.
